findings.quote: We are in network with Delta Dental, Cigna and MetLife
findings.why: The ficha says these carriers are accepted, not that the clinic is in network, so the post makes a stronger insurance claim than the source of truth supports.
findings.fix: Reword to match the ficha, e.g. 'We accept Delta Dental, Cigna and MetLife,' and suggest confirming coverage details with the office.

findings.quote: our front desk can check your benefits before you come in
findings.why: Benefit verification by the front desk is not in the ficha, so it is an unverified claim about how the clinic works.
findings.fix: Remove it, or add it only after the clinic confirms the service.

findings.quote: If you are new to us and paying without insurance, the new patient exam with X-rays is $129.
findings.why: The ficha lists $129 for the new patient exam with X-rays and attaches no 'paying without insurance' condition, so the post invents a pricing condition.
findings.fix: State the price as listed, e.g. 'The new patient exam with X-rays is $129,' without the added insurance condition.

findings.quote: Tartar builds up on a timeline that is similar for most people
findings.why: Tartar buildup varies considerably between people, and this contradicts the post's own later mention of heavy tartar buildup as a reason for more frequent visits.
findings.fix: Say that tartar buildup varies from person to person, which is why the right interval differs.

findings.quote: Ask five people how often they see the dentist and you will hear five answers.
findings.why: This is a formulaic, generic opener typical of AI-written text.
findings.fix: Open with a concrete, specific statement about cleaning intervals.

findings.quote: At each visit the hygienist checks your gums, and the dentist examines your teeth, your bite and the soft tissue in your mouth.
findings.why: This is a general description of a visit, and the ficha does not list hygienists or the exact steps of an exam.
findings.fix: Keep it general or confirm the visit steps with the clinic.
